text: Would love to have given this place some business. They were recommended by another repair company that couldn't fix my car upholstery. Contacted through the web page and got no response. Called and spoke to a gentleman, whose name escapes me, and he didn't seem real enthused to be on the phone. I asked if I could email a photo of the damage so he could assess the repair to which he affirmed and gave me an email address. That was 2 or so weeks ago. No response. Place may do good repairs but I'll never be able to find out.
